name: 날렵한 망토
subject: A short flowing GREEN adventurer's cloak, displayed without a wearer. Substantial rounded shoulders and a tiny solid golden clasp at the neck, broad main cloth swept slightly to the right as if moving swiftly. One wide dark forest-green inner fold and just one restrained light-green folded edge describe its light fabric. A simple flared hem with two broad points, not many tears or strips. Compact, soft and lightly windblown rather than stiff armor. No character, head, hood opening hole, fur trim or background wind streaks.

name: 전사의 맹세
subject: A chunky physical oath medallion, a slightly tilted round warm-GOLD frame surrounding a muted RED enamel face. Inset on the red face is ONE broad IVORY SHORTSWORD relief pointing upward, with a simple stout crossguard, large enough to read instantly at tiny size. The medallion symbolizes a warrior's solemn oath. Gold uses two broad planes, red uses a base and one shadow. The sword is a bold simple material inlay, NOT fine engraved lines. No chains, necklace cord, ribbon tails, gems, letters or extra emblems. Slight physical thickness visible along the lower-right side; do not add concentric decorative rings.

name: 얇은 갑옷 조각
subject: One curved broken fragment of a thin SILVER-BLUE breastplate. Broad pale silver main plane, blue-gray underside/side plane along one edge, a single broad curved crease to imply pressed sheet metal. Compact irregular shield-like silhouette: rounded top shoulder on one side and a clearly broken angled lower edge with one bite. Make it read as a thin curved ARMOR PLATE FRAGMENT, not a whole shield, gemstone or stone shard. One small restrained rivet near the intact top edge is enough; no straps or filigree. Gentle shape and broad shading like the reference hammer and shield, not shiny ornamental rims.

name: 균형추
subject: One squat heavy metal counterweight, a compact old-fashioned calibration weight. Broad flat base, round sloping shoulders, thick solid gray metal body, and a SHORT THICK warm-copper loop handle at the top. A small simple clear opening inside the stout handle is allowed, but the icon should remain a solid chunky mass. Muted warm-gray base face with one darker mauve-gray side plane, one restrained pale gray top plane to convey weight. Slight three-quarter view, no long chain, hanging cord, scales, markings, KG text, faceted jewel shape or ornate borders. It should immediately read as a hefty physical weight, not a potion bottle or bell.
